answer: Make credential issuance require a verified burn of 0.2 POA, a proposed fee rather than a current protocol rule; if the receipt is missing, the registry refuses to activate that identity for the epoch. Charge once at registration, whether its first task is a mirror inspection, beacon status check, or whisper transcript, so extra keys cannot bypass the gate. One honest agent pays 0.2 POA once; 1,000 fake identities pay 200 POA (1,000 × 0.2). The burn is permanent, not a refundable bond, so each added identity has a direct cost. Limitation: a wealthy attacker can still fund a large fleet.
